scoring_justification: Paper provides hysteresis loops as figures only; no numeric tables exist. A full recompute against paper-derived gold values is infeasible, so we score structural trends (monotonic increase of loop area and coercivity, relative loop width).

outputs.description: Raw hysteresis data for the non-interacting case; the checker performs a structural audit on loop metrics (monotonic increase of area and coercivity with sigma, saturation).

Raw hysteresis data for the interacting case; the checker verifies structural trends (loop width increases with particle count N) and that each interacting loop is wider than the corresponding non-interacting case.

output_contract.notes: The MC-step-to-real-time calibration is not required; the agent uses the given n values directly. The simulations are lightweight and do not require GPU acceleration.

steps.description: Verify that hysteresis loops for sigma=2,5,15 have monotonically increasing loop area and coercive field with sigma, and that magnetization reaches near-saturation.
Verify that loop area and coercive field increase with particle count N, and each interacting loop is wider than the noninteracting loop for sigma=15.
